summary: Lincoln County, MT lookout on the Kootenai NF: 1920s cabin and a 72-foot tree platform; abandoned 1942 or 1944; listed Gone; site today not described.

facts.design: frame cabin and a platform built in a tree
facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as Gone; firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts say it was abandoned in 1942 and 1944.

events.note: Firelookout.com lists a cabin and two crow's nests for 1920; Forest Lookouts dates a tent camp with a tree crow's nest only to an uncertain point in the 1920s
Forest Lookouts dates a frame living quarters to 1929
A July 1930 Western News item quoted by Forest Lookouts names Dave Foster as lookout, on a platform built at the top of a tree 72 feet up
Firelookout.com dates a frame cabin to 1931

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com dates a cabin and two crow's nests to 1920 and a frame cabin to 1931. Forest Lookouts dates a tent camp with a tree crow's nest to an uncertain point in the 1920s and a frame living quarters to 1929. Both accounts are kept.
Firelookout.com says abandoned 1942; Forest Lookouts says abandoned 1944. The story gives both years.

notes_for_editor: Brief kind 'ground' is kept, but it is contested: the FFLA list says Ground, while Forest Lookouts describes a 1930 platform 72 feet up a tree, and no source says where the 1929 frame building stood. Editor should decide. Unverified lead: a libbymt.com 2006 article (https://www.libbymt.com/news/2006/07/KootenaiForestcelebr.htm) appeared in search results as mentioning a lookout on McMillan Mountain. Both fetch_text and WebFetch failed on its self-signed certificate, so it is not cited and the TLS check was not bypassed. If a structure still stood in 2006, the gone status would change. Two WebSearch calls and about six reads used.
